title: A Bilingual Booking and E-Commerce Platform
subtitle: Unifying two shops, repairs and retail, into one platform
blurb: Built a bilingual (Spanish/English) website and admin dashboard for Paris Móviles, a mobile repair and electronics retailer in Vitoria-Gasteiz with two physical locations, covering repair bookings, quotations, order tracking, product sales, and full back-office management.
result: Unified two shops into one bilingual platform
whoFor: A business owner in Vitoria-Gasteiz, Spain, operating two physical shops since 2011, one specializing in mobile phone repairs, the other selling phones, accessories, and electronics, who needed a unified digital presence for both.
challengeIntro: The client ran two separate shops with no shared digital system: one for phone repairs, one for retail products. Customers had no way to request repair quotations, book appointments, or purchase products online, and all operations were tracked manually across both locations.
challengePoints: No online channel for customers to request repair quotations or book appointments
No e-commerce presence for the accessories and electronics shop
No centralized system to track orders, inventory, or customer messages across both shops
Needed to serve both Spanish and English-speaking customers
builtIntro: A complete bilingual front-end and back-end system covering both sides of the business, repair services and product retail, with a unified admin dashboard.
builtOutro: The admin dashboard gives the client a single place to manage incoming orders, repair requests, stock levels, product listings, service listings, and customer messages, replacing what was previously handled manually across two separate shop operations.
